- *A Squarespace site is not told nothing is being recorded.* When a Squarespace site had no third-party
  analytics tag, the report said at high priority that nothing about its visitors was being recorded.
  Squarespace counts unique visitors, visits and pageviews itself on every plan, so the report now says
  that instead, as it already did for Wix, and keeps the point that a third-party tag adds what those
  reports do not.

99 checks across 13 areas.
